name: lsd_drv81008
title: 8-channel low-side driver
purpose: Eight protected low-side switches for 28 V valve coils or heaters, driven over SPI (TI DRV81008-Q1)

sources.title: TI DRV81008-Q1 8-channel 40 V low-side driver (SLOSE97B)
sources.licence: TI datasheet; link and quotes only
sources.read: p1 features, p3 pins, p4 ratings (EAS), p14 EAR, p37-39 application and layout, p46-47 PWP0024T package and land pattern

parts.quote: "8-channel, 40V, 700mΩ, Fully Protected Low-side Driver"; "42V minimum drain to the source clamping voltage"; "330mA per output at 85 °C, with all channels ON"; "Integrated clamp circuits on each output dissipates the stored energy during turning OFF inductive loads"; pins per Table 4-1 (24-pin HTSSOP PWP); "Connect the exposed pad to PCB ground for cooling and EMC"

"Bypass capacitor on VM pin 68nF Battery voltage filtering"; "bypassed to GND using low-ESR ceramic bypass capacitor with a recommended value of 68nF rated for VM" (0603 for the 50 V rating: our choice)
"Bypass capacitor on VDD pin 100nF Logic supply voltage filtering"; "A value of 100nF rated for 6.3V is recommended"
"Resistor in series with VDD pin 100Ω Logic supply voltage filtering"
"Resistors in series with IN0, IN1 and nSLEEP pins 4.7kΩ Protection of the microcontroller ... Also to guarantee output channels OFF during loss of ground"

layout.rules: p39: VM capacitor "as close to the VM pin as possible", VDD capacitor "as close to the pin as possible"; "The thermal PAD of the package must be connected to system ground", multiple vias, clear copper around it on the bottom layer

open_questions: Clamp energy (p14): the outputs absorb each coil's turn-off energy ("Maximum Energy dissipation - repetitive EAR 10mJ @ IL_EAR = 220mA"); the valve coils' inductance is not published (Nammo gives power only), so the energy per pulse is unchecked. An external diode across each coil would remove that load but slow the valve's closing.
The optional 10 nF capacitor on each output (Table 7-1, ESD and BCI) is left out: the outputs go to connectors, so it may be worth adding.
The DRV81008-Q1 is automotive-qualified (AEC-Q100), not radiation-tested.
